name: Early Decisions & Redecision
oneLine: The child, not the parent, makes the actual script decision - which means it can be unmade. A redecision replaces a self-limiting early decision with a new one.
whatYouDid: You proposed Imran's early decision - 'I'm tolerated here, not wanted, unless I'm flawless' - and a redecision he could make now, as an adult who's just survived the typo that was supposed to be a catastrophe.

fromBook.quote: The child always has the option of turning an injunction around in this way to create positive instead of negative outcomes.

expand.definition: Redecision therapy (Bob and Mary Goulding) holds that because the original decision was made from feeling rather than thinking, changing it means re-contacting that feeling level, not just reasoning past it with Adult argument.
expand.otherFraming: TA Today's own closing image for the whole project of change, in the chapter on aims of change, is a short poem about a hole in the sidewalk: first you fall in and it's not your fault, then you fall in and know it's a habit, then you walk around it, and finally you walk down another street entirely - a redecision is that last street.
expand.tryThisToday: Name one self-limiting belief you can trace to a specific early scene, and write one sentence of what a grown-up, resourced version of you would decide instead.
